{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old wooden facades do the storytelling; walk slow and let them."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done with quiet precision, and the set bowls are properly vegan."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Lantern light, narrow lanes, and the river just a shoulder-width away."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The wooden stage hangs over the hillside like a dare. Go early, before the tour groups find their voice."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal path where cherry petals drift slower than the walkers. Shoes off at the little shrines along the way."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The Silver Pavilion never got its silver, and it’s better for it. The sand garden is a quiet kind of theatre."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Ten thousand torii, one long orange tunnel. The deer will cope without you; the gates won’t wait."}]}
Gion ease, eastern paths, green Arashiyama, calm craft — every must-do tucked in, shoes off, eyes up.
